_comment: §2.1.9 escape budget over a DECLARED scope. g-escape-budget recomputes the structural-escape rate over the clean fixtures (which must be 0) and the round-trip declared subset, fails when the rate exceeds maxStructuralEscapeRate, and — the ratchet — fails when the measured rate is MORE than 0.05 below the cap without the cap being lowered in the same commit. The direction is down only.
